# Knowledge graph evidence fixtures

`rich.jsx` and `same.jsx` are controlled syntax inputs, never executed. Native
Tree-sitter JavaScript 0.25.1 / grammar 0.25.0 and the existing AstBuilder produce
schema-1 `syntax-preorder-v1` ASTs. The read-only Python JavaScriptExtractor and
its validators generate metadata; the existing JavascriptResolver generates
resolution artifacts. Project DTO fixtures use actual producer models and
validators, including an explicit unsupported TypeScript source outcome.

The inputs cover repeated direct call sites, recursive/nested calls, repeated
names across scopes/files, constructors/methods/fields, local heritage, class
static initialization, binding reads/writes, a catch binding with AST-only
evidence, and unresolved import/property calls. Graph tests additionally reuse
all nine existing Relationship Analysis fixture families for ambiguous,
dynamic, mutated-binding, module syntax and syntax-error cases. Relationships
are generated by the actual Relationship analyzer in the test helper.

Regenerate only this module's fixtures, from the repository root:

```sh
node --import tsx src/modules/knowledge-graph/tests/generate-fixtures.mts
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
PYTHONPATH=/home/dilawar-khan/codeatlaspythonbackend/codeatlas-backend \
/tmp/codeatlas-metadata-venv/bin/python -B \
  src/modules/knowledge-graph/tests/generate-metadata-fixtures.py
node --import tsx src/modules/knowledge-graph/tests/generate-resolution-fixtures.mts
```

Routine Vitest tests do not start Python or require network access except for
local loopback HTTP API tests. Traversal-only tests use clearly marked graph
algorithm fixtures, independent of entity/edge construction evidence.
`../live-integration.mts` separately verifies the actual HTTP pipeline, two
analysis snapshots, persistence and query/traversal with real Node/FastAPI
services and task-owned temporary directories. Python source remains unchanged.
